sovereign_country.strategic_role: 支持全中文章程、传统华人客群离岸家族信托常驻地

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Offshore Marine Fuel Bunkering and Lubricant Replenishment

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: No comprehensive bilateral investment treaty in force as of the current review cycle; Samoa participates in WTO, PACER Plus regional trade facilitation, and a network of bilateral MLATs and TIEA-type arrangements.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act 1987 (as amended) governs the International Company register and its confidence protections; Money Laundering Prevention Act 2007 (as amended) and the directives of the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit impose mandatory customer due diligence and beneficial ownership identification on licensed registered agents, banks and trust and company service providers.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized passport or national identity copy of each director, shareholder and ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport issuing authority and notary public in the owner's country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (if country of origin is an Apostille Convention state) or consular legalization via the nearest Samoan consulate/embassy and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Samoa

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement within last 3 months)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Bank or utility provider in country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized copy with Hague Apostille or consular legalization; bank/utility direct verification may be accepted by the registered agent for AML purposes

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Banker or professional reference letter verifying identity, reputation and source of funds
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Existing bank or regulated professional in the UBO's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Direct authenticated bank reference or notarized letter with consular/apostille certification when specifically demanded by the Samoan FIU or bunkering counterparty

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Draft Memorandum and Articles of Association (including ISIC 5222 bunkering and supply purpose clause)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Samoa-qualified formation counsel and licensed registered agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Signatures acknowledged by notary and registered agent certification; no apostille required if executed in Samoa

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Corporate authorization resolutions confirming the UBO and approved marine gas oil / lubricant replenishment activity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Certified true copies by the Samoan registered agent; apostille/legalization only if required by charterers' banks or port authorities

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: UBO and anti-money-laundering due diligence statement (Form SIFA-AML/UBO/001)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Registered agent and AML compliance officer
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Internal compliance authentication; not a public document and not subject to apostille/consular legalization

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening against the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit directives, United Nations Security Council consolidated sanctions and Al-Qaida/ISIL lists, OFAC SDN list, EU consolidated sanctions, and Samoan domestic criminal and money-laundering watchlists. PEP status requires approval by the registered agent's AML Compliance Officer and increased monitoring of source of wealth and funds. Each authorized signatory, beneficial owner, commercial counterparty and bunkering vessel operator must be re-screened on every new supply transaction and at least every 90 days.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) - International Companies Registry; name clearance is processed by licensed Samoan registered agents using SIFA's Oracle-based internal registry system (no direct public filing portal).
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The registered legal name must be in Roman script and must include a permitted suffix (Limited, Inc., Corp., Ltd.). Names in traditional Chinese may be adopted only as a non-registered bilingual/trade name, provided a romanized transliteration is appended in corporate records; Chinese characters alone cannot form the legal name. The Registrar compares the romanized transliteration for distinctiveness and public-policy screening.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Within 14 days of a formal refusal the applicant's licensed registered agent files SIFA Form IC-NA2 with the Registrar, a written appeal, a statutory declaration on distinctiveness and the prescribed SIFA appeal fee (currently fixed at USD 60). The Registrar must decide within 10 business days. If the appeal is dismissed, the applicant may apply to the Supreme Court of Samoa under the Civil Procedure Rules for judicial review of the refusal. A refusal based on a conflicting name can be cured by a notarized letter of consent from the prior-name holder. No extension of the 30-day reservation is normally permitted unless an appeal or court order is pending.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible only to the extent that the International Company's registered office is a physical address in Samoa maintained by a licensed registered agent that is accessible for service of process. A generic virtual mailbox, serviced office or shared co-working address without a licensed Samoan registered agent does not satisfy section 4 of the International Companies Act 1987 and will not be accepted by SIFA.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low-to-moderate. For a non-resident shell International Company used for foreign bunkering, the annual probability of an unannounced SIFA/government inspection is estimated at less than 5%. If the company obtains a Samoan port permit, petroleum storage licence or maritime supply licence, the probability rises to between 20% and 30% across a three-year compliance cycle, due to customs, tax administration, port safety and AML spot checks.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name search, clearance and reservation application (single proposed name)
Certificate of Incorporation filing fee and standard share capital drafting (International Company)
First-year annual government licence fee for an International Company
UBO/AML/CFT onboarding: KYC documents, PEP and sanctions screening, beneficial ownership statement, compliance sign-off (per UBO)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed Samoan registered agent / AML compliance officer

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered office in Samoa and registered agent representation services (first year)
Notarization, apostille or consular legalization of corporate and UBO identity documents (up to five items)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary public, issuing government authority, and Samoan consulate or Ministry of Foreign Affairs as applicable

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified translation of Articles, trust and constitutional documents into Chinese/English for bilingual family-trust and Chinese customer-facing documentation
External Samoan legal opinion on ISIC 5222 offshore marine fuel bunkering and lubricant replenishment licensing, with sanctions end-use analysis
Bank account and trade-finance documentary compliance pack for Swift wire and standby LC opening (resolutions, sanctions attestations, UBO bank forms)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Corporate services provider / external counsel for FIU-compliance documents

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 2008 (Samoa), sections 4, 7, 9, 11, 12 and 15 (incorporation, subscribers, registered office, directors and secretary); read with the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2015.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Apia, Samoa.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association in the prescribed form under section 7(2) of the International Companies Act 2008, filed with the Registrar of International Companies.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital is prescribed under Samoan law; the stated authorised share capital is to be fully subscribed by the initial subscribers. No escrow or capital deposit requirement applies. The Registrar levies an annual government fee (currently USD 300) after incorporation.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED THAT the subscribers' share subscription in the authorised share capital of the Company be and is hereby ratified and accepted as satisfied in full, and the issuance of the subscribed shares to the subscribers be approved. RESOLVED FURTHER THAT the registered office of the Company be established at the address of the licensed registered agent in Apia, Samoa, and that the registered agent be instructed to effect filing of all statutory notices. RESOLVED FURTHER THAT the following persons be and are hereby appointed as director and secretary respectively for the Company: [Name 1] – Director, and [Name 2] – Secretary, each to serve until removal or resignation in accordance with the Articles.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Engagement of Licensed Registered Agent and Name Reservation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, MCIL (via licensed registered agent)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Engage a Samoan licensed international company registered agent. Submit three proposed company names to the Registrar through the agent for reservation. The name must not be identical or confusingly similar to an existing company, and must end with 'Limited' or an approved abbreviation. Obtain the reservation certificate.
required_dossiers: Duly executed engagement letter with registered agent
Identity documents of subscriber(s) (passport and proof of residential address)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused, submit an alternative name within 5 working days; if the reserved name is considered misleading, amend the proposed name or obtain consent letters from affected parties.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Execution of Constitutional Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association based on the standard form of the International Companies Act 2008. Provide full details of share capital, subscriber shares, objects (including ship bunkering and fuel supply), and elect to have limited liability. The Memorandum must be signed by each subscriber in the presence of a witness; the signatures must be notarised or certified by a lawyer entitled to practice in Samoa.
required_dossiers: Consent to act as director and secretary (signed by each appointee)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar queries any clause in the Memorandum, the registered agent may file a revised version within 10 working days. A corrected filing fee may apply if the defect is caused by the applicant.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of Incorporation Application and Payment of Fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Through the registered agent, submit the incorporation application via the MCIL e-registry or in-person window, including the executed constitutional documents and the application form. Pay the incorporation fee of USD 350 and the registration agent filing fee. The Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation upon verification.
required_dossiers: Executed Memorandum and Articles of Association
Consent forms of director and secretary
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is rejected for incomplete documentation, the applicant has 14 days to cure defects by filing supplementary documents. If the Registrar issues a certificate with an error in the company name, apply for a certificate of correction within 7 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Appointment of Registered Office and Registered Agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Designate a registered office in Samoa at the address of the licensed registered agent, and ensure that the registered agent is formally appointed. The registered office address must be a physical location, not a post office box, and must be maintained continuously.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registered office is not accepted, update the address within 5 days and re-file the notice of change through the agent.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Holding of First Board Meeting and Adoption of Resolutions
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Company board of directors / corporate secretary
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting (physically or by virtual means permitted under the company's Articles) to ratify the issuance of shares, adopt the registered office, and appoint officers. Record the minutes and the board resolutions, and enter them into the company's statutory records. The first board resolution is set out above in the incorporation legal framework.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If any officer refuses to act, the board may pass a supplementary resolution to appoint a replacement; update the records and file a notice of change of officer with the Registrar if required.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Application for Tax Identification Number and Exemption Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministry of Revenue, Samoa (in coordination with the registered agent)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File an application for a Tax Identification Number (TIN) for the international company, and request an International Company Tax Exemption Certificate under the International Business Activities Act 2004, confirming that the company is exempt from income tax on its foreign-sourced income and is not subject to exchange control. Provide the certificate of incorporation and constitutional documents.
required_dossiers: Copy of board resolution on tax exemption election
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the TIN or exemption certificate is delayed, submit a written reminder through the agent; if the exemption is denied due to the company having Samoan-source income, restructure operations to ensure offshore-income only, then re-file the application.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Samoa Ports Authority and Ministry of Transport (Maritime Division), with joint oversight by the Samoa National Petroleum Policy Implementation Committee.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Marine Fuel Bunkering and Supply Licence (Petroleum Products Supply Licence) issued under the Petroleum Act 1972, the Petroleum Products Amendment Act 1984 and the Ports Authority Act 1998, plus the Bunkering Operations Permit.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MNRE), Planning and Urban Management Agency (PUMA)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 2 – Development Consent / EIA Preliminary Assessment required for marine fuel transfer and bunkering facilities, as the activity involves potential discharge, storage and transfer of petroleum products.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance with the Marine Pollution Prevention Act 2008 (MARPOL Annex I and IV regulations): no oily water discharge in excess of 15 parts per million; no discharge of oil or oily mixtures within 12 nautical miles of the Samoan coastline; vapour recovery or control during bunkering transfers to limit volatile organic compound (VOC) emissions to 95% capture efficiency; hazardous waste handling and disposal under the Waste Management Act 2005, with storage and spill containment measures conforming to best international practice.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certificate issued by the National Fire Services Authority (NFSA) covering the bunkering barge or shore-based storage facility, including fire suppression and emergency access verification; structural load inspection and certificate of seaworthiness for bunkering vessels issued by the Maritime Division of the Ministry of Transport; workplace clearance and occupational health and safety assessment under the Occupational Safety and Health Act 2012, including a forklift and crane operation clearance for physical fuel transfer equipment, and vessel-to-ship transfer system inspection report approved by the Ports Authority.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Ministry of Revenue, Government of Samoa (MOR); online portal: https://www.revenue.gov.ws
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign entity seeking to establish a taxable presence or obtain a tax identification number must file the Business Registration Form (Form MOR-BR1) with the Ministry of Revenue, accompanied by the certificate of incorporation, memorandum and articles of association, proof of registered office address, and notarised passport copies of officers/shareholders. For VAT purposes, the entity must submit the VAT Registration Application (Form MOR-VAT1) and, where applicable, a bunkering licence from the Samoa Ports Authority and Marine Safety Administration. The Ministry of Revenue issues a combined TIN-VAT registration number upon verification of incorporation records and confirmation of a physical or licensed presence in Samoa.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: International Companies are generally treated as tax-exempt offshore entities and are excluded from the ordinary income tax regime under the International Companies Act 1987 and the Income Tax Act 2012. No check-the-box or hybrid mismatch election is available for Samoa domestic law; an International Company may, however, elect in writing to be treated as a resident company for tax purposes if it obtains a Samoa business licence and derives income from Samoa sources, thereby triggering standard corporate income tax and VAT registration obligations. Hybrid mismatch rules under the Anti-Avoidance provisions apply to deny double non-taxation benefits.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under the Goods and Services Tax Act 1992 and amendments, administered by the Ministry of Revenue
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: WST 60,000 taxable turnover in any 12-month period; voluntary registration permitted for lower turnover where taxable supplies are being made
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Samoa has not yet introduced a real-time electronic fiscal clearance or continuous transaction control system. VAT-registered persons are required to issue a tax invoice containing the words 'tax invoice', the supplier's name, address and VAT registration number, the recipient's name and address, a description of the supply, the date, the consideration exclusive of VAT, and the VAT charged. Tax invoices must be retained for five years. There is no API-based e-invoicing mandate, digital stamping requirement, or pre-clearance of invoices through the Ministry of Revenue system; the Ministry of Revenue may, however, require electronic submission of VAT returns and supporting schedules through its online portal.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Supplies of goods exported from Samoa and directly connected services (including ship bunkering and lubricant replenishment for vessels operating in international trade) are zero-rated. To claim the zero rate, the supplier must be a VAT-registered person and obtain documentary evidence proving the supply has been exported or provided to a non-resident for use in international commerce, including evidence of the vessel's departure from Samoa waters, proof of payment from the non-resident, and confirmation that title and risk passed outside Samoa.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Samoa Customs Service Export Declaration (Customs Form CED-01)
Bill of Lading or other shipping document evidencing export of bunker fuel
Bunker Delivery Note (BDN) signed by the master or chief engineer
Port clearance certificate issued by Samoa Ports Authority
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank notification evidencing payment in foreign currency
VAT zero-rated supply schedule accompanying the VAT return
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Zero-rating claims are subject to audit scrutiny by the Ministry of Revenue, which may require production of the full documentation bundle within 30 days. Where the export documentation is incomplete or fraudulent, the VAT claimed as zero-rated is clawed back with interest at the statutory rate, the taxpayer is liable for a penalty of 200% of the tax underpaid for fraudulent claims and 100% for negligent claims, and criminal prosecution may result in a fine of up to WST 50,000 or imprisonment of up to three years. Additionally, the Customs Service may impose forfeiture of the goods and disqualification of a bunkering licence for false declarations.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Samoa maintains an exchange control regime under the Exchange Control Act 1976 and the Exchange Control Regulations, administered through authorized dealer commercial banks with the Central Bank of Samoa (CBS) as the principal regulator. The Samoan tala (WST) is a partially convertible currency. Current account transactions (e.g., trade payments, service fees, and operating remittances) are generally permitted, subject to documentary evidence of underlying trade and CBS-authorized dealer reporting. Capital account transactions, including capital injections, loans, and repatriation of share capital from a non-resident International Company, fall under CBS exchange control approval and require prescribed declaration forms and transactional back-up documentation. Dividend and profit remittance is legally permissible for an International Company that is tax-exempt under the International Companies Act 1987; however, the remitting agent must demonstrate tax clearance/confirmation from the Ministry of Revenue, audited financial soundness, identified beneficial ownership, and compliance with CBS reporting thresholds. There are no standing impediments to profit remittance for a compliant non-resident-owned Samoa International Company provided all filings are made through an authorized dealer and CBS approval is obtained where the underlying obligation is classified as a capital transfer.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under Samoa's exchange control framework, export proceeds from a Samoa International Company's foreign-currency bunkering sales must be repatriated through an authorized dealer bank in Samoa within 180 days from the date of shipment or date of completion of bunkering delivery. All export receipts are required to be reported to the Central Bank of Samoa. The prescribed mandatory conversion ratio into Samoan tala (WST) is 100% for export receipts unless the CBS grants a specific written exemption on a case-by-case basis, ordinarily available for an offshore International Company whose business receipts are retained in foreign currency for operational settlement in marine fuel procurement. Documentary evidence required includes a commercial invoice, bunker delivery receipt (BDN), vessel IMO number, charter contract, and a CBS export declaration form.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account only; standby letters of credit and trade finance preferred through offshore ANZ affiliate

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: LOW. Samoa has no domestic fintech EMI (electronic money institution) licensing framework that would allow an offshore digital EMI to be treated as a licensed deposit-taking institution or authorized dealer. An offshore digital EMI is legally constrained by the Banking Act 2000 and CBS licensing and exchange control regulations from opening a banking account on a standalone basis for a Samoa International Company. Practical workarounds, such as receiving funds through a foreign-licensed EMI and then routing onward to a Samoa-authorized dealer bank, create sanctions-screening and counterparty-liability gaps in respect of marine-fuel trades; therefore, the treasury blueprint requires all liquidity to settle via licensed commercial banks or regulated clearing banks with SWIFT connectivity rather than EMI rails.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: For a Samoa International Company, a physical board appearance by all directors is not an absolute mandatory requirement where the bank has a compliant remote onboarding process. However, each tier-1 bank's KYC policy typically requires at least one director or an authorized signatory with documented authority to undergo a live video conference, plus submission of certified copies of passports through a reputed professional introducer (registered agent, law firm, or public accountant) who holds a current practicing certificate in Samoa. Under the ECB (Exchange Control Regulation), the bank may waive face-to-face interview for a non-resident natural-person director only where an existing banker's reference or professional reference confirms identity to a reasonable assurance standard. In practice, BBC-style virtual onboarding with two-factor identity verification, notarized corporate resolutions, and certified passport copies is accepted; the bank will also independently verify beneficial owners by cross-checking against sanctions and politically exposed persons (PEP) databases. Any indication of unreported beneficial ownership or unexplained source of wealth will force a physical in-person interview at the bank's Apia head office.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Offshore International Company structure with nominee shareholders and/or bearer shares flagged as opaque beneficial ownership
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified copy of Certificate of Incorporation under the International Companies Act 1987; current Certificate of Incumbency or Registry Extract listing directors, shareholders, and secretary; a full beneficial ownership schedule identifying all ultimate natural persons (name, nationality, date of birth, residential address); notarized declaration of beneficial ownership; certified resolutions of directors authorizing account opening; formation-agent registered with the Samoa International Finance Authority.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Marine bunkering and ship refueling activity identified as high-risk sector associated with trade-based money laundering, sanctions evasion, and vessel-covert activities
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed bunkering supply contract or master fuel sale agreement; final invoice and Bunker Delivery Note (BDN) with IMO number; vessel flag registry certificate optionally validated via EQUASIS or IMOSEA by the bank; AIS historical track and geofenced delivery coordinates; end-use attestation letter; warranty that no UN, EU, UK-HMT, or OFAC sanctions apply to the buyer, vessel, cargo, port, or beneficial owner; P&I insurance certificate for the vessel involved; charter party highlighting voyage route and delivery port.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Source of wealth / source of funds not demonstrable for capital escrow account funding in marine fuel trader context
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Account-opening source of wealth questionnaire; audited balance sheet of the International Company or an audited group-level parent if newly incorporated; certified bank statements of the beneficial owners for the immediately preceding 12 months; sale and purchase agreements evidencing prior bunkering contracts; tax indemnity letter confirming tax-exempt status; accountant's money-laundering reporting officer (MLRO) approval memorandum.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unexpected correspondent-banking or sanctions screening hits on a bunkering counterparty due to port or ship identity similarity
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: OFAC, EU, UK-HMT and UN sanctions screening clear-shot evidence; enhanced due-diligence (EDD) file with vessel IMO number verified via Lloyd's List/Equasis, beneficial-owner attestation, geofencing AIS logs, port authority clearance, and certificate of delivery from the master or chief engineer; instruction to the bank to route payment only via a pre-approved correspondent with sanctions-identifier validation on the SWIFT payment message.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound capital injections into the Samoa International Company must be funded by the ultimate non-resident beneficial owner's own foreign-currency bank account. The compliant protocol uses an SWIFT MT103 wire transfer narrative with purpose code 'CAPITAL / EQUITY CONTRIBUTION' and reference to the CBS Exchange Control approval number (where required; CBS approval is required if the country of remittance treats the transaction as a capital transfer or where the amount exceeds the CBS threshold). The beneficiary bank will screen the remitter, correspondent banks, and beneficiary against UN, OFAC, EU, UK-HMT, and CBS watchlists before crediting. A complete verification set must include the sanctioned wiring instruction from a regulated introducing bank, the signed board resolution evidencing acceptance of the share premium or equity contribution, a source-of-funds declaration, and a CBS Capital Import Form or Exchange Control Declaration applicable at the time of remittance. The capital escrow account is segregated from operational cash roll and cannot be used to support short-term marine fuel payment; it must remain as evidence of minimum capitalization and standby liquidity support. Once cleared, the funds may be converted to the bunker supply operating account through an authorized dealer with an FX purchase contract and customs/exchange-control filing referencing the business purpose code for marine fuel inventory acquisition.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound disbursements for bunker fuel, lubricant replenishment, port agency fees, and surveyor costs are settled via SWIFT MT103 for onshore fuels and service invoices below USD 250,000 invoice value and via a Commercial Letter of Credit issued through the International Company's account in Samoa (MT700/MT707) for bulk marine fuel procurement where the bank has a trade-finance relationship with the supplier's bank. Standby LCs (MT760) are used as a performance guarantee for the delivery of bunker fuel or as an indirect backing for trade credit lines. Before each outbound MT103, the operations controller must forward the commercial invoice, bunker receipt copy, BDN, reconciliation of pipeline quantity, and payment-clearing warrant confirming payee background and absence of sanctions/red flags. The bank uses the SWIFT CMS-Payment purpose code '1097' (marine fuel payments) where permitted, or the general trade-payment code for commercial services, with mandatory inclusion of invoice number on the payment narrative. Settlement to high-risk maritime suppliers is limited to direct bank transfers to named payee accounts previously vetted and added to the bank's payee security list; no payments to payable-through accounts, cash or bearer instruments, or third-party transporters without pre-approval are allowed.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore WST/USD forward contracts executed through an authorized dealer for documented trade payables, provided that a physical trade contract exists and the CBS underlying-deal principle is met

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) hedged offshore via an international bank not licensed in Samoa, with valuation references to Samoan tala (WST) official exchange rate, used exclusively for net position balancing where no deliverable WST market is economically viable
Cross-currency swaps (WST/USD) arranged through an offshore treasury counterparty for alignment of long-term bunker storage purchase contracts and terminal facility lease obligations

Option contracts (over-the-counter) written by a major international bank against USD/WST where the Cambodia structure would recognize the underlying fuel procurement as a genuine commercial exposure, obtaining a legal negative-clearance legal opinion that such derivative does not violate CBS exchange-control restrictions on unauthorized back-to-back currency conversions

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return (International Companies Act 2012, as amended)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Apia, Samoa
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days (one month) after each anniversary of incorporation; filed through the licensed registered agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty in Samoan Tala plus a daily additional penalty; persistent default empowers the Registrar to initiate administrative strike-off and dissolution.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual International Company License Fee (International Companies (Fees) Regulations)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA), Apia, Samoa
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due on the anniversary of incorporation each year; payable through the licensed registered agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: 10% surcharge on the unpaid fee plus daily interest; non-payment beyond 6 months triggers administrative strike-off, disqualification of the registered agent, and loss of tax-exempt status protections.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Bunkering / Marine Fuel Supply License Renewal (industry license)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Samoa Ports Authority (SPA) and the petroleum licensing regulator under the Petroleum Act and port by-laws
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually before 31 December (or the license anniversary date fixed by the Samoa Ports Authority), submitted with evidence of P&I cover and operational compliance
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Operating without a current license is an offence; fines under the Petroleum Act and port by-laws of up to approximately WST 50,000, suspension of bunkering privileges, and port access revocation.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Companies / Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit (AML/CFT Act 2017)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Filed concurrently with the Annual Return, within 30 days (one month) of the incorporation anniversary
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Offence penalties under the AML/CFT Act 2017 and Beneficial Ownership Regulations for failure to confirm or update UBO details; repeat default triggers a compliance inspection and potential strike-off referral.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Audit of a Samoa International Company is not mandatory on a routine basis. A statutory audit is compulsory only if the company (i) holds a license to carry on banking, insurance, trust, or other prescribed financial activity; (ii) is listed on a securities exchange or issues public debt; (iii) is directed by the Registrar under the International Companies Act 2012; or (iv) is required by the Samoa Ports Authority as a condition of the bunkering license. For a private, non-licensed bunkering/refueling IC, audited financial statements are generally not required; unaudited management accounts will normally satisfy internal and financing requirements.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) as issued by the IASB; the International Companies Act 2012 requires the keeping of accounting records sufficient to disclose with reasonable accuracy the company's financial position at any time. Samoa International Companies are tax-exempt on offshore income and are not required to file a Samoan income tax return.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under the International Companies Act 2012 and the AML/CFT Act 2017, the company must keep a current register of beneficial owners at its registered office in Samoa. Every share transfer affecting beneficial ownership must be executed by a transfer instrument, recorded in the Register of Members, and reflected in the UBO register; changes must be notified to the Registrar. A signed annual beneficial-ownership confirmation certified by the licensed registered agent must accompany the Annual Return filed within 30 days of each incorporation anniversary.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 600 - USD 1,200 per annum covering the licensed registered agent, registered office facility, annual return preparation, and corporate secretarial compliance
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,500 - USD 3,500 for a single-entity bunkering IC where an audit is required by license condition or prescribed activity; generally not incurred for a non-licensed IC under audit exemption

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: A licensed International Company (IC) formed under Samoa's International Companies Act 1987 is statutorily exempt from income tax under section 116 of that Act, producing a 0% effective corporate tax rate on qualifying foreign-source marine fuel bunkering and lubricant replenishment income; standard Samoa resident companies not holding IC status are subject to CIT at 27%, with incentives available under the Investment Promotion Act and sector-specific tax holiday and deduction schemes.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Samoa Company Income Tax Return (Form IR2) lodged through the Samoa Inland Revenue Authority (SIRA) electronic taxpayer portal; an exempt IC files a nil/exemption return attaching the International Companies Act 1987 exemption certificate and licence number.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual; quarterly provisional tax instalments apply only where the IC or company has assessable Samoan-source profits.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Final IR2 return is due within six months after the company fiscal year-end; a company with a 31 December balance date must file by 30 June; SIRA may grant an extension of time upon written application.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Aggregate invoiced revenue from marine fuel bunkering, refuelling services, lubricant sales and ancillary vessel-supply charges.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: IC: insert 0 and refer to IC Act exemption; non-IC non-resident company: declare only income sourced in Samoa.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Demurrage, tank-storage fees, laytime compensation, agency commissions and incidental maritime service fees.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Fees sourced to services performed in Samoa are assessable; foreign-source fees of an IC remain exempt.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: IC tax-exempt income, treaty-exempt shipping income, and legislated incentive exemptions.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State full exempt balance and cite IC Act s. 116 or the applicable double tax agreement article.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Fuel procurement costs, chartered-vessel hire, port and canal charges, crew and logistics costs, insurance, finance costs, and depreciation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Deductions are matched only against assessable Samoan-source income; an exempt IC should retain full backing ledgers for audit trail.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income computed as assessable income less allowable deductions and loss carryforwards.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: IC: 0. Non-IC branch: positive balance subject to 27% CIT.
IC: 0. Non-IC: apply 27% to Samoan-source net income.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Resident withholding tax credits, final WHT credits, foreign tax credits, and provisional tax paid.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach SIRA withholding certificates (Forms IR5/IR6/IR7) and a foreign tax credit computation for any treaty-residence taxes.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 8: Net Tax Due or Refund
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Balancing payment due to SIRA or refund arising from excess credits.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: IC: no payment due; ensure the nil return is stamped by SIRA to close the filing obligation.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing attracts a penalty of 10% of the tax assessed, plus 2% per month on default; late payment incurs 10% after 30 days and a further 2% monthly; continued default triggers SIRA assessment, collection enforcement, asset seizure, and deregistration at the Registrar.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: International Company Annual Return and Economic Substance (ESR) Notification filed online through the Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) and the Samoa International Companies Registry.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due within 30 days after the anniversary of incorporation for the notification, and within 12 months of the IC financial year-end for the economic substance return and statutory records confirmation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: IC name, registration number, registered agent, date of incorporation, director and shareholder details.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors are permissible; the agent must maintain current UBO details on the register.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of relevant activities under ESR Rules, here marine fuel bunkering and lubricant replenishment, categorised as shipping-related maritime services.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Declare the activity even where all income is non-Samoan; the ESR regime is activity-based, not profit-based.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Section C: Income and Assets Profile
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross income, net income, total assets and the percentage attributable to the relevant activity.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report worldwide figures for the IC; confirm that exempt status does not remove ESR reporting obligations.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Number of full-time and part-time employees, physical premises owned or leased, annual operating expenditure, and location of core income-generating activities.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Document Samoan board meetings, strategic decisions, bunkering procurement management and accounting records kept in Samoa.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to file the ESR notification attracts an administrative penalty of WST 5,000 plus daily accrual, with strike-off or deregistration under the International Companies Act; the registered agent can be fined and the IC's name disclosed to the Samoan tax authority and exchange-of-information partners.
